supersession_reason: The published CMD dark-matter grids use adaptive 32-neighbour smoothing, whereas the TNG and EAGLE Hong targets use direct particle assignment. A development-only SIMBA CV16 raw audit measured an operator-sized high-k difference, so v2 freezes one raw-particle CIC operator for every suite before any new Swift-EAGLE or Astrid truth is read.
purpose: Permit new cross-code model development after the sealed V13 EAGLE failure without using that failure for tuning, while preserving one genuinely untouched public simulation family for a one-time gate.

allowed_uses: retain the immutable V13 decision and metrics
report the historical failure after V14 is frozen
forbidden_uses: amplitude, seed, threshold, or gate tuning
opening additional RefL0100N1504 cubes as a replacement independent test

tng100.partitions: unchanged repository V13 train and validation partitions

camels_simba.historical_stress_policy: report only after development selection; never fit or select on it

camels_swift_eagle.reason: Public Swift hydrodynamics with EAGLE subgrid physics supplies an EAGLE-like development shift without reopening the sealed EAGLE RefL0100N1504 truth.
camels_swift_eagle.training_observers: all subhalos satisfying the frozen observer stellar-mass interval
camels_swift_eagle.validation_selection: exactly 16 observers chosen once by deterministic maximin coverage of the eight observable V8 context features; no target or density feature may enter
camels_swift_eagle.truth_access: permitted only after this firewall is committed

sealed_independent_domain.objects: one observer per realization, chosen by the frozen stellar-mass-only rule
sealed_independent_domain.observer_choice: candidate closest in log stellar mass to the geometric midpoint of 4e10 to 1e11 Msun in the existing CAMELS catalog convention, with subhalo index as deterministic tie breaker
access_firewall: Do not download, mmap, inspect, summarize, or derive any Astrid density target before the V14 model, checkpoint, preprocessing, representative rule, and gate command are frozen and committed.
Do not use Astrid catalog observables for training, normalization, architecture choice, or checkpoint selection.
After freeze, prepare all 27 objects and open the field gate exactly once.
A failed gate remains failed; no alternate checkpoint, seed, realization subset, correction, or threshold is tried on Astrid.

field_gate.checks: the same eight checks and thresholds used by V13

allowed: fit and compare models using only TNG100, SIMBA development, and Swift-EAGLE development
use target-free observable context at inference
train a conditional multiscale location-scale likelihood rather than apply a post-hoc transfer function
require simultaneous unchanged field-gate passes on all three development validation domains
forbidden: simulation identity as an inference feature
post-hoc A(k) or truth-derived amplitude correction
any EAGLE RefL0100N1504 or Astrid-driven model choice

locked_order: download and schema-audit Swift-EAGLE development data
implement and select V14 only on the three development domains
freeze and commit the exact V14 artifact hashes and one-shot command
download and prepare the sealed Astrid inputs
run the Astrid field gate once
run Astrid grid-HOP only after a field pass
advance to CF4 application or forward dynamics only after the complete independent gate passes

unavailable_preferred_alternative.policy: Do not claim Magneticum as an executable independent gate unless access is granted under a separately committed protocol.
